evidence: Configure Fields dialog offers Text/Number/Date/Checkbox options. Added "Notes" (Text); it immediately appeared in table headers [Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes] and in the Add New Entry form as a text input with placeholder "Enter notes".

Field-type dropdown lists labeled options "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox". Entry form renders input[type=text] for Task Name, input[type=number] for Priority, input[type=date] for Due Date, and button[role=checkbox] for Completed.

issue: New entries are not persisted across page reload
actual: Created entry "Zebra QA test entry" (Priority 9, Mar 7 2026, Completed=Yes, Notes="QA note alpha"). It appeared immediately and the counter went 5 -> 6 entries. After reloading http://localhost:6074/, the table showed only the original 5 entries ("5 entries") and the new entry was gone. The added "Notes" field was also lost. Object.keys(localStorage) returned [] — no state is persisted anywhere.
evidence: Post-reload headers: [Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed]; rows: the 5 seed entries only.

Saved text "Zebra QA test entry", number 9, date 2026-03-07, checkbox=checked, notes "QA note alpha". Table row shows: Zebra QA test entry | 9 | Mar 7, 2026 | check icon | QA note alpha. Card shows same: heading + Priority 9, Due Date Mar 7 2026, Completed "Yes", Notes "QA note alpha".
Clicked Cards after Table: counter stayed "6 entries" and all six entries retained identical field values (e.g. "Prepare quarterly report" 1 / Jan 25, 2026 / No in both views).
All 6 entries and all 5 fields render in both views. Empty Notes values are shown as an em dash "—" in table cells and in card field values, a clear empty representation.

Entry form checkbox shows literal "No"/"Yes" text and data-state unchecked/checked. Table: checked = lucide-check with class text-success, unchecked = lucide-x with text-muted-foreground. Cards: "Yes" / "No" text with icon.

Priority renders as input[type=number]. Pressing "a" left the value at "0" (no non-numeric text accepted); Playwright fill("abc") was rejected outright. Valid value 9 was accepted and saved, displayed as "9" in table and card.
Due Date renders as input[type=date]. Setting "2026-02-31" (invalid calendar date) resulted in value "" — not saved. Valid "2026-03-07" was accepted and displayed as "Mar 7, 2026" in both views.

Selecting Priority immediately reordered cards to 1,1,2,2,3,9. The Sort button relabels to "Priority" with a lucide-arrow-up icon (asc); re-selecting flips to lucide-arrow-down and order 9,3,2,2,1,1. Active field is also check-marked in the menu, which gains a "Clear sort" item. App remained fully interactive.

Count stayed "6 entries" across asc and desc sorts. Every field value unchanged, e.g. Zebra QA test entry 9/Mar 7 2026/Yes/QA note alpha, Team sync meeting notes 2/Jan 14 2026/Yes/—, Design new landing page 1/Jan 15 2026/No/—. Only ordering differed.

Sort menu lists all 5 configured fields. Cards sorted by Priority asc (1,1,2,2,3,9) then desc (9,3,2,2,1,1). Table independently sorted by Task Name asc. Switching Cards->Table->Cards->Table preserved each view's own sort: Cards stayed "Priority" arrow-down, Table stayed "Task Name" arrow-up.

issue: Field-specific filtering feature is entirely absent
actual: The app exposes no filter UI. Toolbar contains only: search box, Sort menu, Table/Cards toggle, Add Entry; header has only "Fields". The only icon-only buttons in the page are per-row pencil (edit) and trash (delete). A DOM-wide text scan for /filter/i matched only CSS <style> blocks — no filter control, no filter panel, and no per-column filter affordance. There is therefore no way to define field-specific filter criteria or to clear them.
evidence: Button labels present: Fields, Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes, Table, Cards, Add Entry, plus icon-only pencil/trash2 only.

issue: Cannot verify filter inclusion/clearing because filtering does not exist
actual: No filter criteria can be applied at all (no filter control anywhere in the DOM), so there is no active-criteria matching to evaluate and no "clear filters" action to restore data.

issue: Data import feature is entirely absent
actual: There is no import control in the app: no input[type=file] elements (count 0), no Import/Upload/CSV/JSON/Paste button or menu item anywhere in the DOM. The Configure Fields dialog only contains field rows, an add-field row, a Close button, and the advisory text "Note: Changing field types may affect how existing data is displayed. Configure fields before importing data." — but no import entry point exists, so importing data and type-mismatch rejection cannot be performed.

evidence: Typing "MARKETING" (uppercase) into the search box matched "Review marketing materials" case-insensitively; visible rows dropped to 1 and the counter changed from "6 entries" to "1 entry". Clearing the box restored all 6 rows and the "6 entries" counter.

issue: Quick search matches internal raw values instead of the formatted values shown to users
actual: Dates: the UI displays "Mar 7, 2026", but searching "Mar 7" and "Mar 7, 2026" each returned "0 entries", while the raw ISO value "2026-03-07" returned 1 entry (Zebra QA test entry). Likewise displayed "Jan 15" returned 0 entries. Checkboxes: the UI displays "Yes"/"No", but searching "Yes" returned "0 entries" while the raw boolean "true" returned 3 entries (the three checked rows). Searching "No" returned 2 entries that are merely text substring hits ("Team sync meeting notes", "Zebra QA test entry" via note text) and excluded the actual unchecked entries (Design new landing page, Update API documentation, Prepare quarterly report).

evidence: With sort cleared in each view, dnd-kit sortable handles allow reordering. Table: moved "Design new landing page" down one -> [Review, Design, Update, Prepare, Team, Zebra]. Cards: moved it down two -> [Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Zebra]. Switching Cards->Table->Cards preserved each view's own distinct manual order; count stayed 6 entries.
